title.zh-CN: 反复咯血与逐渐憋气 · 42岁女性
title.en: Recurrent haemoptysis and progressive breathlessness · woman aged 42

summary.zh-CN: 长期反复咯血后出现呼吸受限，需辨别中心气道病变与常见肺部原因。
summary.en: Longstanding recurrent haemoptysis is followed by airflow limitation; distinguish central-airway disease from common pulmonary causes.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 间断咯血10年，憋气半年，加重1个月
chiefComplaint.en: Intermittent haemoptysis for ten years and breathlessness for six months, worse for one month

triageNote.zh-CN: 近一个月再次咯血伴憋气，能平卧，无本次发热；需复核气道安全。
triageNote.en: Another month of haemoptysis and breathlessness, able to lie flat without current fever; airway safety needs review.

text.zh-CN: 气道黏膜广泛增生，最窄处约正常管径10%，易出血；病理无定形物质刚果红阳性，λ强阳性。血尿免疫固定无单克隆带，未行骨髓检查。
text.en: Extensive friable airway mucosal growth with a narrowest calibre about 10% of normal; amorphous deposits were Congo-red positive and strongly lambda positive. Serum/urine immunofixation had no monoclonal band; marrow assessment was not performed.

text.zh-CN: 报告多次硬镜、电烧与冷冻处理，并曾气切及使用系统药物。7个月后拔除气切管，FEV₁升至1.71 L；11个月无呼吸困难或咯血，可轻体力活动。多项治疗不能分离各自效果。
text.en: The report used repeated rigid bronchoscopy, thermal/cryo treatment, tracheostomy and systemic medicines. Decannulation occurred at seven months, FEV₁ reached 1.71 L, and at eleven months there was no breathlessness or haemoptysis with light activity. Effects of individual treatments cannot be separated.

prompt.zh-CN: 流量环和CT最支持什么定位？
prompt.en: What localisation is best supported by the flow loop and CT?

need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 固定性中心气道阻塞，应有计划地获取组织并评估气道风险
text.en: Fixed central-airway obstruction requiring planned tissue assessment and airway-risk evaluation

feedback.zh-CN: 管壁广泛病变与固定流量环相互一致。
feedback.en: Widespread wall disease and the fixed flow-loop pattern agree.

text.zh-CN: 典型可逆性哮喘足以解释全部结果
text.en: Typical reversible asthma explains all findings

feedback.zh-CN: 固定狭窄和钙化性壁病变不符合单纯哮喘解释。
feedback.en: Fixed stenosis and calcified wall disease are not explained by asthma alone.

text.zh-CN: 听诊无啰音即可排除危急气道狭窄
text.en: Absence of crackles excludes critical airway stenosis

feedback.zh-CN: 听诊不能替代结构及通气证据。
feedback.en: Auscultation cannot replace structural and functional evidence.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 组织支持气道淀粉样沉积，但系统性程度仍需评估
text.en: Tissue supports airway amyloid deposition, while systemic extent still needs assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 阴性免疫固定与正常器官检验有帮助，未行骨髓等资料仍有边界。
feedback.en: Negative immunofixation and organ tests help, but missing marrow and other data retain limits.

text.zh-CN: 阴性免疫固定绝对排除任何系统受累
text.en: Negative immunofixation absolutely excludes systemic involvement

feedback.zh-CN: 单一筛查不能替代完整分型与器官评估。
feedback.en: One screening test does not replace full typing and organ assessment.

text.zh-CN: 易出血一定证明气道癌
text.en: Friability proves airway carcinoma

feedback.zh-CN: 活检显示沉积而不是肿瘤细胞，外观不能取代组织。
feedback.en: Biopsy shows deposits rather than malignant cells; appearance cannot replace tissue.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何选择安全的气道与系统管理？
prompt.en: How should airway and systemic management be planned safely?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 介入呼吸与麻醉团队规划高出血风险的气道处理，并由专科评估沉积类型及系统受累
text.en: Interventional pulmonology and anaesthesia should plan high-bleeding-risk airway care, with specialist amyloid typing and systemic assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 极窄易出血气道需要救援能力，历史联合化疗不能作为默认方案。
feedback.en: A very narrow friable airway requires rescue capability; historical chemotherapy is not a default regimen.

text.zh-CN: 在无气道救援条件下常规活检即可
text.en: Routine biopsy without airway rescue capability is sufficient

feedback.zh-CN: 严重狭窄及易出血使常规取材具有额外风险。
feedback.en: Severe narrowing and friability make routine sampling hazardous.

text.zh-CN: 直接复制马法兰或沙利度胺用于所有局灶病例
text.en: Copy melphalan or thalidomide for every localised case

feedback.zh-CN: 系统药物适应证与风险需重新分型评估。
feedback.en: Systemic-drug indications and risks require reassessment of disease type.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：用固定性流量环定位中心气道病变。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：完整淀粉样分型、骨髓检查、心脏沉积证据及长期复发。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Localise central-airway disease from a fixed flow-loop pattern. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Complete amyloid typing, marrow assessment, evidence of cardiac deposition and long-term recurrence. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告为弥漫性气管支气管淀粉样变性并严重中心气道狭窄，系统性受累评估有限。
conclusion.en: The report describes diffuse tracheobronchial amyloidosis with severe central-airway stenosis and limited systemic assessment.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 完整淀粉样分型、骨髓检查、心脏沉积证据及长期复发。
unknowns.en: Complete amyloid typing, marrow assessment, evidence of cardiac deposition and long-term recurrence.

references: 李楠, 王广发, 章巍, 张红, 张晓明. 腔内介入治疗弥漫性气管支气管淀粉样变性一例. 中华结核和呼吸杂志. 2013;36(07):540-542. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.1001-0939.2013.07.020.

testUtterances.text: 咯血已经有多久？
How long has haemoptysis been occurring?
以前是否反复咳出血来？
Has coughing blood happened repeatedly before?
憋气是怎样逐渐加重的？
How has breathlessness progressed?
最近喘不过气有没有更频繁？
Has difficulty breathing become more frequent?
晚上能平躺睡觉吗？
Can you lie flat at night?
躺下会不会更喘？
Does lying down worsen breathing?
这一次有没有发烧？
Has there been fever in this episode?
最近体温升高了吗？
Has temperature risen recently?
最近胃口和体重有什么变化？
How have appetite and weight changed?
有没有吃得少或瘦下来？
Have you been eating less or losing weight?
以前心律有什么问题？
What previous rhythm problem was there?
过去有心律失常吗？
Was an arrhythmia diagnosed before?
是否吸烟或常接触清洁剂？
Do you smoke or regularly encounter detergents?
家里工作中有烟或清洁化学品接触吗？
Is there smoke or cleaning-chemical exposure at home or work?
以前有没有药物过敏方面的情况？
Could you describe any medicine allergies?
以前有没有家族病史方面的情况？
Could you describe any family illnesses?
以前有没有既往手术方面的情况？
Could you describe any earlier operations?
